value.zh-CN: 输入框内容，可用 `bind:value` 绑定。只传值时作为初始内容，之后由组件自己维护；`bind:value={get, set}` 使其完全受控。
value.en-US: Content of the input; bind it with `bind:value`. A plain value is the initial content, which the input then maintains itself; `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled.

size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small.

type.en-US: The type of the native input.

mode.zh-CN: 输入框模式，可选 password，显示密码显隐按钮。
mode.en-US: Input mode; password shows a button that reveals or hides the text.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读，同时隐藏清除按钮。
readonly.en-US: Whether the input is read-only; it also hides the clear button.

readOnly.zh-CN: 是否只读，只锁定输入，清除按钮仍可用（选择器类组件依赖它）。
readOnly.en-US: Whether the input is read-only, locking typing only; the clear button stays (pickers rely on it).

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the input has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

showClearIgnoreDisabled.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 DatePicker 使用：禁用时仍可清除。
showClearIgnoreDisabled.en-US: Internal property used by DatePicker: the clear button stays available while disabled.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不调用 onChange，组合结束后调用一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; onChange is not called during a composition and is called once after it ends.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的聚焦。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus inside the component.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时自动获取焦点（使用 preventScroll）。
autofocus.en-US: Focuses the input on mount, using preventScroll.

maxlength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxlength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minlength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minlength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the input is empty.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 input 元素的样式字符串。
inputStyle.en-US: Style string of the native input element.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 所在元素的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the element around the insetLabel snippet, for aria-labelledby to point at.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxlength、minlength 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxlength and minlength.

onChange.zh-CN: 内容变化时调用，参数为新值与事件；输入法模式下组合结束后调用一次。这是 Input 自己的回调，不是原生 change。
onChange.en-US: Called when the content changes, with the new value and the event; in IME mode it is called once after the composition ends. This is the callback of Input, not the native change.

onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is activated.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入组件时调用；焦点在输入框与组件内按钮之间移动不调用。事件为外层元素的 focusin。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the component; moving focus between the input and its buttons does not call it. The event is the focusin of the wrapper.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组件时调用。事件为外层元素的 focusout。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the component. The event is the focusout of the wrapper.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时调用（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不调用。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called when Enter is pressed (keydown); the Enter that commits an IME composition does not call it.

onCompositionStart.zh-CN: 输入法组合开始时调用。
onCompositionStart.en-US: Called when an IME composition starts.

onCompositionUpdate.zh-CN: 输入法组合更新时调用。
onCompositionUpdate.en-US: Called when an IME composition updates.

onCompositionEnd.zh-CN: 输入法组合结束时调用。
onCompositionEnd.en-US: Called when an IME composition ends.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
prefix.en-US: Prefix. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
suffix.en-US: Suffix. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

addonBefore.zh-CN: 前置标签。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
addonBefore.en-US: Addon before the input. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

addonAfter.zh-CN: 后置标签。内容仅为文本或 Semi 图标时自动带上左右间隔。
addonAfter.en-US: Addon after the input. Text or a Semi icon alone gets horizontal spacing automatically.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when showClear is true.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦原生 input；未传 preventScroll 时使用同名属性的值。
focus.en-US: Focuses the native input; the preventScroll prop applies when the option is not given.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the input.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置选区，参数同原生 setSelectionRange。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native setSelectionRange.

getInput.zh-CN: 返回原生 input 元素，未渲染时为 null。
getInput.en-US: Returns the native input element, or null while it is not rendered.

getNativeElement.zh-CN: 返回组件根元素，未渲染时为 null。
getNativeElement.en-US: Returns the root element of the component, or null while it is not rendered.

value.zh-CN: 文本内容，可用 `bind:value` 绑定。只传值时作为初始内容，之后由组件自己维护；`bind:value={get, set}` 使其完全受控。
value.en-US: Content of the text area; bind it with `bind:value`. A plain value is the initial content, which the text area then maintains itself; `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled.

autosize.zh-CN: 高度是否随内容自适应，可传 `{ minRows, maxRows }` 限制行数。
autosize.en-US: Whether the height follows the content; pass `{ minRows, maxRows }` to limit the rows.

cols.en-US: Visible width in average character widths.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the text area is empty.

maxCount.zh-CN: 字数上限，设置后显示字数统计；超出时计数器标红，不截断输入。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of characters; setting it shows a counter, which turns red when exceeded. The input is not truncated.

showCounter.zh-CN: 是否显示字数统计；设置 maxCount 时总是显示。
showCounter.en-US: Whether to show the counter; it is always shown when maxCount is set.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the text area has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

disabled.en-US: Whether the text area is disabled.

readonly.en-US: Whether the text area is read-only.

autofocus.en-US: Focuses the text area on mount.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error、warning；error 时输出 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning; error outputs aria-invalid.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不调用 onChange，组合结束后调用一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; onChange is not called during a composition and is called once after it ends.

disabledEnterStartNewLine.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 Chat 使用：Enter 不换行，Shift + Enter 换行。
disabledEnterStartNewLine.en-US: Internal property used by Chat: Enter does not start a new line, Shift + Enter does.

lineNumberClassName.en-US: Class name of the line number area.

lineNumberStyle.zh-CN: 行号区域的样式字符串。
lineNumberStyle.en-US: Style string of the line number area.

textareaStyle.zh-CN: 内部 textarea 元素的样式字符串，可设置高度等。
textareaStyle.en-US: Style string of the inner textarea element, such as its height.

resize.zh-CN: 是否允许拖拽调整尺寸及方向，可选 none、both、horizontal、vertical、block、inline；仅在显式传入时生效，autosize 开启时忽略。
resize.en-US: Whether and in which direction the user may resize: none, both, horizontal, vertical, block or inline. It only takes effect when given and is ignored with autosize.

maxlength.zh-CN: 最大长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它计算长度并截断，否则使用原生属性。
maxlength.en-US: Maximum length. With getValueLength the length is measured and truncated by it; otherwise the native attribute applies.

minlength.zh-CN: 最小长度。传入 getValueLength 时按它换算，否则使用原生属性。
minlength.en-US: Minimum length. With getValueLength it is converted accordingly; otherwise the native attribute applies.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 maxlength、minlength、maxCount 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with maxlength, minlength and maxCount.

onChange.zh-CN: 内容变化时调用，参数为新值与事件；输入法模式下组合结束后调用一次。这是 TextArea 自己的回调，不是原生 change。
onChange.en-US: Called when the content changes, with the new value and the event; in IME mode it is called once after the composition ends. This is the callback of TextArea, not the native change.

onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is activated.

onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the component.

onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the component.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时调用（keydown），输入法组合中的回车不调用。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called when Enter is pressed (keydown); the Enter that commits an IME composition does not call it.

onResize.zh-CN: 尺寸变化时调用：autosize 导致高度变化时参数为 border-box 高度；拖拽调整尺寸时为内容区的 height 与 width。
onResize.en-US: Called when the size changes: with autosize the payload is the border-box height; when the user drags to resize it is the content-box height and width.

onCompositionStart.zh-CN: 输入法组合开始时调用。
onCompositionStart.en-US: Called when an IME composition starts.

onCompositionUpdate.zh-CN: 输入法组合更新时调用。
onCompositionUpdate.en-US: Called when an IME composition updates.

onCompositionEnd.zh-CN: 输入法组合结束时调用。
onCompositionEnd.en-US: Called when an IME composition ends.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the text area.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置选区，参数同原生 setSelectionRange。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native setSelectionRange.

getTextarea.zh-CN: 返回原生 textarea 元素，未渲染时为 null。
getTextarea.en-US: Returns the native textarea element, or null while it is not rendered.

getNativeElement.zh-CN: 返回组件根元素，未渲染时为 null。
getNativeElement.en-US: Returns the root element of the component, or null while it is not rendered.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 large、default、small；组内任意深度未自行设置 size 的控件取这个值。
size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small; controls at any depth in the group that set no size of their own take it.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，组内任意深度的控件取这个值；控件自己写的 disabled 优先。
disabled.en-US: Whether the group is disabled; controls at any depth in the group take it, and a disabled a control sets itself takes precedence.

label.zh-CN: 渲染一个命名该组的 FormLabel，配置为 Form.Label 的属性，另可设 id、class、style；`name` 会成为该组的 id。节点内容使用 fieldLabel、labelExtra snippet。
label.en-US: Renders a FormLabel that names the group, configured with the Form.Label props plus id, class and style; `name` becomes the id of the group. Use the fieldLabel and labelExtra snippets for node content.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 标签位置，可选 top 或 left。

fieldLabel.en-US: Node content of the label, in place of `label.text`.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组内元素获得焦点时调用（focusin），焦点在子级之间移动也会调用；不下发给子级。
onFocus.en-US: Called when an element in the group gains focus (focusin), including when focus moves between children; it is not passed to the children.

onBlur.zh-CN: 组内元素失去焦点时调用（focusout），焦点在子级之间移动也会调用；不下发给子级。
onBlur.en-US: Called when an element in the group loses focus (focusout), including when focus moves between children; it is not passed to the children.

children.en-US: The input components in the group, such as Input, InputNumber, Select, AutoComplete, TreeSelect, Cascader and DatePicker.
